title: runstate v0.2 lifecycle convention
description: Pins the bodies of the lifecycle.* topics the worker produces: started (attach + self-reported liveness handle), heartbeat (tick beacon), stopped (cooperative dying breath), nak (a refused control request). Applied on top of the envelope schema.

Started.description: Pushed on attach; the worker self-reports its liveness handle (§8).

Heartbeat.description: Tick-driven liveness beacon. consumed_seq is the worker's read position in its inbound `control` order (§11-12), published after durable registration.

Stopped.description: The cooperative dying breath; its existence on the log = a clean, resumable halt (§7). completed=true is the worker's opt-in claim of intrinsic completion; otherwise the stop projects to preempted. error is the failure diagnostic; a completed stop carries no error.

Nak.description: A refused control request, correlated by request_id. `reason` is a closed enum: malformed (body didn't conform -- a sender bug), unsatisfiable (well-formed but provably zero fires), unsupported (unknown control verb). `message` is free human detail.
